facts.fact: SeyLII's record of the Seychelles Bureau of Standards Act, 2014 (Act 2 of 2014) shows it repealing the earlier Bureau of Standards Act, commenced 16 June 2014 and amended in 2016 and 2021; only the citation and history page is captured, not the Act's text.

note: Citation page only; no IT or data standard and no certification stated.
